about: The reference board: the art seen with no match running (the Bevy client's ?pose mode, ci/look.mjs on SwiftShader), beside references and the operator's marks. node tools/board.mjs look shoots every view and draws the sheet; build first (cargo build --release -p server, ci/client.sh). The fx-* views are the fx stage's strips (tools/fx.sh, the fx skill): one effect over a dark and a light card, every frame of it, measured against the plate and the last run.

views.name: A fighter, facing you
views.what: a fighter facing the camera with a long gun, in the arena
views.take: a silhouette you read as an enemy at a glance, and where to aim

views.name: A fighter, side on
views.what: a fighter side on with a long gun
views.take: the body and the gun read apart; the head is the obvious target

views.name: A fighter with a pistol
views.what: a fighter side on with a pistol
views.take: which gun someone holds, from across the room

views.name: A fighter running away
views.what: a fighter running away with a heavy weapon
views.take: motion and the weapon read from behind

views.name: Bulkhead: red's deck
views.what: Bulkhead from red's deck, 3 m up, over the pit to blue's base
views.take: the whole map reads from home: the bridge, the pit, both lanes, which base is whose

views.name: Bulkhead: bottom mid
views.what: the pit under the bridge, from beside red's low wall
views.take: the pit is its own place: cover to fight around, the lifts, the bridge overhead

views.name: Bulkhead: top mid
views.what: on top mid with the sniper, looking down the bridge at blue's deck
views.take: the long sight line and where it's exposed; the far base reads as blue

views.name: Bulkhead: a side lane
views.what: red's end of the north lane, looking along it
views.take: the lane is a route of its own, and the steps down into the pit read

views.name: Chrysalis: red's top
views.what: from red's base top through its window, over top mid to blue
views.take: the bubble reads as one curved wall, the window frames top mid, the far base reads as blue

views.name: Chrysalis: bottom mid
views.what: in the pit beside a pod, top mid and the stem overhead
views.take: an alien interior, not a box: the pods, the stem and the platform overhead read at a glance

views.name: Chrysalis: top mid
views.what: on top mid by the stem, looking at blue's base
views.take: where the fights are reads; the hull's veins glow without hiding fighters

views.name: Chrysalis: the south hall
views.what: red's end of the south hall, the ramp up to blue's top ahead
views.take: the hall is a route of its own, the ramp and the landing read

views.name: Effect: a round on metal
views.what: a rifle round on metal on the fx stage: dark card left, light card right
views.take: a white-hot star for a frame, sparks that streak and cool to ember and skitter once, a small grey puff; reads with bloom off (the browser has none)

views.name: Effect: a round on a shield
views.what: a rifle round on a fighter's shield on the fx stage
views.take: a blue-white crack of light, arcs crawling and gold specks thrown off; no dust, no blood: the shield took it

views.name: Effect: a sniper round on concrete
views.what: a sniper round into a wall on the fx stage
views.take: heavier than a rifle's: more grit and a bigger puff, a few sparks; the mark left on the card

views.name: Effect: a rifle's muzzle
views.what: the rifle's muzzle flash on the fx stage
views.take: a star and a tongue of fire for a frame or two, a breath of grey smoke after; nothing hangs

views.name: Effect: a frag going off
views.what: a grenade's blast on the fx stage, framed for 2.2 m
views.take: a flash, an orange fireball that cools to red, sparks thrown wide, then smoke that rises and hangs; the light card shows the smoke's body

views.name: Effect: a rocket going off
views.what: a rocket's blast on the fx stage, framed for 2.4 m
views.take: bigger than the frag: more fire, more smoke, the same order of flash, fire, sparks, smoke

views.name: Effect: a shield breaking
views.what: a fighter's shield breaking on the fx stage
views.take: the shell bursting: a ring of light and shards of it thrown off; quick
